howCounted: The current season's annual salary is observed from MFL. Future years carry that annual salary through expiration and may change after an extension or restructure; MFL does not report those years separately. Missing or expired expiration yields only the current salary, not a guessed term. No UFA cost or dead-cap figure is computed.
